site.name: BhaktiYatra
site.tagline: Explore the sacred heart of India
site.description: Discover India's temples: darshan timings, history, festivals and how to reach. Book organised pilgrimage tours.

footer.tagline2: Temple guides and organised pilgrimages across India.

home.heroTitle: Explore the sacred heart of India
home.heroSubtitle: Darshan timings, history, festivals and how to reach India’s great temples, all in one place.
home.featuredCircuitsText: Traditional routes that link great shrines, from the Himalaya to the southern sea.
home.featuredTemplesText: Start with some of the most visited and revered temples in India.
home.why1Text: Darshan and aarti timings, how to reach, rules and the best season to visit.
home.why2Text: Char Dham, the 12 Jyotirlingas and other routes, in their traditional order.
home.why3Text: Organised yatras with clear itineraries are coming soon.
home.why4Text: Call or write to us and a person will answer.
home.enquiryText: Tell us where you would like to go and we will help you plan.
home.upcomingToursText: Guided yatras with fixed dates, stays and transport.
